changelog:
- Provides OOMOL/`oo` CLI access to the public OpenFootball World Cup JSON dataset.
- Lists World Cup groups, teams, matches, stadiums, squads, and qualification playoff data when available.
- Uses live connector schemas before each action to ensure payloads match the authoritative contract.
- Treats all available actions as read-only dataset queries, with no account connection required.
- Notes that match data comes from a community dataset and is not an official real-time results source.
